name: Sioux County, IA
findings: Sioux County has 163 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sioux County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
